subject: Elara Labs — pricing target and commitment scenarios
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Khan <sara@elara.ai>, Elara Labs Procurement <procurement@elara.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery — infra, token patterns, and budget (quick recap)

Hi Sara / Elara team,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the thoughtful product walkthrough. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get a tailored commitment proposal to you: 

Recap from today's call:
- Primary use case: interactive agent layer for customer support + re-ranking pipeline for search.
- Traffic profile: expected steady-state prompts + responses equivalent to ~50M tokens/month initially with growth to ~180–220M tokens/month by Q4 if pilot performs. Peak sequence lengths ~512 tokens; 90th percentile shorter.
- Latency SLO target: p95 generation <= 350ms for UI flows.
- Compliance: data residency in us-west region, standard SOC2 controls ok.

Budget / unit-econ signals you shared:
- FY28 pilot budget: roughly $160k–$220k for the first 6 months of run (includes infra + services).
- Internal target blended cost: ~ $900 / 1M tokens (this is the target the engineering/product team mentioned).

What we need from you to finalize scenarios (small asks):
1) Confirmation of the initial 3-month and 6-month target volumes (pick conservative vs aggressive).
2) Any procurement constraints or preferred contract term (monthly invoicing vs annual/PO + net-30).
3) If Elara qualifies as an early-stage startup (founder ownership & < $10M ARR), we can apply our startup program; please confirm so we can layer that into the model.

Next steps from Redwood side:
- Ben will draft 2 commitment scenarios (6-month pilot commitment + optional 12–24 month follow-on with stepped discounts and multi-year rebate).
- I will attach a pricing workbook with line items and a short SOW stub for procurement to review.

Attachments: pricing_workbook.xlsx (workbook with sample bands), elara_sow_v1.pdf (draft SOW, very lightweight).

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sara Khan <sara@elara.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elara Labs Procurement <procurement@elara.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: Discovery — infra, token patterns, and budget (quick recap)

Connor — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Volumes: the engineering team expects a conservative pilot of ~60M tokens/mo (user-facing UI + small batch rerank) with optimistic ramp to 200M tokens/mo if okay after the pilot. For modeling please prepare both 60M and 180M monthly scenarios.
- Budget: procurement gave us a hard range for the pilot (first 6 months) of $150k–$180k. That number must include any fixed onboarding fees.
- Startup status: Elara closed a small seed round in 2025, ARR is sub-$3M, so we'd like to confirm startup pricing eligibility.
- Discounts: we are most interested in a combination of (a) an upfront committed-use discount for guaranteed monthly minimums and (b) a short-term founder/early-stage credit on the first 3 months. Can you show a blended $/1M figure for each scenario?

Procurement asks: if you can provide a clear 6-month pilot proposal that fits under $180k (all-in) we can loop in legal next week. Also please call out any termination clause for the pilot (we need a 30-day out option).

Thanks — Sara
Sara Khan
Head of Product | Elara Labs
sara@elara.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Khan <sara@elara.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RE: Discovery — infra, token patterns, and budget (quick recap) — proposed scenarios

Sara — appreciate the clarity. Pushed a first-pass worksheet into the attachment (pricing_workbook.xlsx) and summarized two concrete scenarios below. Both assume US-West hosting and SOC2 plan. Startup credit is applied to scenario A.

Scenario A — Pilot (startup credit applied)
- Term: 6 months
- Volume profile: 60M tokens/month baseline (pilot)
- Unit rate (base): $1,200 / 1M tokens
- Startup founder credit: 30% credit applied to first 3 months usage (reduces effective $/1M to $840 for months 1–3)
- Committed discount: 15% discount on list for months 4–6 if minimum 60M/mo maintained
- Estimated all-in cost (6 months): ~$165,000 (includes onboarding fee $5k + support hours) — fits under your $180k ceiling

Scenario B — Pilot + multi-year pathing (aggressive ramp)
- Term: 6 month pilot + optional 2-year extension
- Pilot months 1–6: assume average 90M tokens/mo (blended)
- Unit rate (base): $1,100 / 1M tokens
- Committed-use tiering: 10% discount for 6-month commitment; if you convert to a 12–24 month commitment we ladder to 20–30% depending on size
- Multi-year incentive: 12–24 month commit with rebate (~10% of spend back as credit at year end for 2-year commit)
- Estimated pilot cost (6 months): ~$225,000 (pilot only) — we can structure to bring pilot under $180k by increasing founder credit or converting some fees to credits on conversion

Callouts and flexibility:
- We can apply an early-stage founder credit only for customers that meet our program criteria; we'll need a quick form from your side (simple eligibility confirmation).
- We can move onboarding fees to credits if Elara signs a 12–24 month follow-on; common compromise to keep pilot within budget.
- Termination: 30-day out during pilot period is acceptable; post-conversion terms vary by commitment.

Next steps: 
1) Connor / I will update the workbook with a variant of Scenario A showing a 35% founder credit + zero onboarding fee to see if that nets <= $150k for you.
2) If that lines up, we can produce a lean PO-ready SOW and a DocuSign link for signatures.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Khan <sara@elara.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Elara Labs Procurement <procurement@elara.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RE: Discovery — infra, token patterns, and budget (quick recap) — next steps

Sara — thanks, Ben — great options. Quick confirmation and immediate asks so we can turn this into a PO-ready package by EOW: 

Confirmations we need from Elara today:
- Pick which pilot profile to price: (1) conservative 60M/mo baseline or (2) blended 90M/mo (we'll attach both and highlight the one you prefer).
- Startup eligibility: please reply with a short confirmation (e.g., "Elara qualifies as early-stage startup: yes") and a pointer to the cap table or investor email to validate if you can. That unlocks the founder credit in the workbook.
- Procurement timing: do you expect legal to require redlines or is this standard PO + SOW? If legal, what's the expected turnaround?

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- I'll upload variant A (35% founder credit, onboarding fee converted to credit) to the Drive and re-run numbers so Scenario A shows ~ $145k–$155k all-in for 6 months.
- Ben will prepare a lean SOW and *optional* 12–24 month conversion language (with rebate mechanics) for procurement to review.
- If Elara confirms, I will send a DocuSign link for signature on the pilot SOW + PO template by Thursday.

If helpful, we can hop on a 20-min call this afternoon to walk procurement through the workbook.

Best,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
